title: Cybernetic Portrait — music-reactive 3D robot head app (screen capture)
summary: A single continuous screen capture of a desktop app window ('Cybernetic Portrait — Afterimage preview') floating over a blurred backdrop. Left: a real-time 3D porcelain-and-black robot head whose crown wings, temple drums, shell slices and pose react to the music, wrapped in callout labels (CROWN.WING 056, NECK.LIFT 101) and a dial ring with motion-blur afterimages. Right: a dark control panel with audio meters (KICK, SNR, HATS…), Routes/Mechanisms/Look tabs and dozens of sliders tagged with orange modulation chips (Kick, Loudness, LFO 1). Feels like a high-end creative-coding demo.
fit_reason: Impressive tech demo, but it is a static app capture of a 3D toy; the only transferable idea is 'real UI window floating on a blurred backdrop with callout labels on the hero object'.
